name: soft_side_light
prompt: Fixed front camera view of a compact yellow SO-101 robot arm on a gray tabletop. The robot carries one small blue cube from a white taped three-by-three grid and places it on a green square pad to the left of the grid. Keep the same camera framing, robot parts, blue cube, green pad, table markings, object positions, and arm movement as the input video. Realistic plastic and metal materials. Soft daylight from a large window on the left adds a mild directional highlight and slightly longer soft shadows across the table, with neutral 5000 kelvin white balance. The blue cube remains blue and the pad remains green.
